name: ARREIT
recent: ARREIT 近期出现多项董事会及委员会人事变动，包括审计委员会、风险委员会成员及多位董事的更换，同时也有主要管理人员变动。公司另有两项未指明内容的 OTHERS 公告。
notable: Puan Norhaizam binti Mohammad 出现审计委员会、风险委员会及董事会职务变动。
Cik Aida Rohayu binti Abidin 出现董事会变动。
Datuk Mohd Radzif bin Mohd Yunus 及 Datuk Mohd Iskandar Dzulkarnain bin Ramli 出现董事会变动，Encik Ahmad Jefri bin Abdul Rashid 与 Mr Low Swee Lim 出现主要管理人员变动。

recent_en: ARREIT has seen multiple board and committee changes recently, including changes in the Audit Committee, Risk Committee and several directors, along with changes in principal officers. The company also issued two OTHERS announcements with unspecified content.
notable_en: Puan Norhaizam binti Mohammad had changes in Audit Committee, Risk Committee and Boardroom roles.
Cik Aida Rohayu binti Abidin had a change in Boardroom.

Datuk Mohd Radzif bin Mohd Yunus and Datuk Mohd Iskandar Dzulkarnain bin Ramli had Boardroom changes, while Encik Ahmad Jefri bin Abdul Rashid and Mr Low Swee Lim had changes in Principal Officer roles.
